description:
One user of YOUR platform (white-label), looked up by your own user id: display
    name, wallets with their trust status, X/Telegram/KOL badge, trading stats per
    chain for the period (volume, realized PnL, win rate), the latest trades and
    theses. Use for "How is user 42 on my platform doing this week?".

    Only for platforms that import their users into a CabalSpy ID instance
    (white-label). For CabalSpy ID users who signed in themselves use csid_profile.
    Needs your own CabalSpy API key with a CabalSpy ID instance (no demo).

external_id.description: The user's id on YOUR platform (external_id), as you passed it when the user was created or imported, e.g. 'did:privy:abc123' or '42'.
external_id.title: External Id

instance.description: Your CabalSpy ID instance (its client_id, e.g. 'csid_1a2b…'). Only needed when your account has several instances. Leave empty otherwise.
instance.title: Instance

period.description: Statistics window: 6h, 1d, 7d or 30d. Longer windows return far more data and get trimmed harder, so prefer the shortest window that answers the question.
period.title: Period

name: csid_platform_user
